name: Send Telegram alerts when followed tennis players start, win a set or finish

parameters.content:
## Live tennis score alerts to Telegram

### How it works
Every 20 minutes the workflow reads the live matches from Live Tennis API and keeps those of the players you follow. It compares each match with the previous run. Telegram gets a message when a match goes live, when a set ends and when the match finishes. A match that leaves the live list is read again until it shows its final score and winner, retirements and walkovers included. It is read every run for an hour, then less often, for up to a week. Clubs and coaches get a ping instead of refreshing a scores page.

### Setup
1. Create a **Header Auth** credential. Its Name is `X-API-Key` and its Value is your Live Tennis API key. Select it on every HTTP Request node.
2. Create a Telegram bot with @BotFather and add a **Telegram** credential with its token.
3. In **Config**, set `followedPlayerIds` (comma-separated ids, found with `GET /players?search=`) and `telegramChatId`.
4. Activate the workflow. It remembers what it saw only between active runs, not manual tests.

### Customization
Change the schedule to poll faster on a paid plan. Edit the message text in the two Code nodes.

The free plan allows 100 requests a day. Every 20 minutes is 72. A match awaiting its result adds three in its first hour, then one an hour for a day, then four a day.

Tested on n8n 2.44.6.

## Read and compare
One request lists every live match. The Code node keeps followed players and finds what changed since the last run.

## Finished matches
A match that left the live list is read again until its result is in, for up to a week.
